snippet.title: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4587610/Dice_Tavern_Farkle_Roguelike

Dice Tavern is a roguelike deckbuilding game built around the classic rules of Farkle. Collect 35 unique dice, combine 43 Synergies and put your luck to the test in a candlelit medieval tavern. Use dice as your weapon and luck as your wager. This time, will you Roll Again or Take the Win?

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Cavi Studio
📚 Publisher: HARRISONWORLD CO.,LTD
📅 Release Date: Sep 7, 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Strategy
